stem: Lito sold 4 shirts at ₱150 each and 1 shirt at ₱200. What is the average price of the 5 shirts?
hints: Four shirts cost ₱150 but only one costs ₱200. Should the two prices count equally?
The total is ₱800 for 5 shirts. Divide the total by the number of shirts.

solution.methodName: Weighted average: add group totals, divide by total count

steps.why: Each of the 4 shirts adds ₱150 to the total.
Every shirt counts once, so the ₱150 price, which appears 4 times, pulls the average down toward ₱150.

trapNotes.₱175: This is halfway between ₱150 and ₱200. But 4 shirts cost ₱150 and only 1 costs ₱200, so the average is pulled closer to ₱150.
trapNotes.₱200: This is ₱800 ÷ 4. There are 5 shirts in all (4 + 1), so divide by 5.
trapNotes.₱800: This is the total price of all the shirts. Divide it by 5 to get the average price.
